# Getting help

bridgewatch is a tray monitor for GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, maintained by
Distronode under the Apache License 2.0. Where to go depends on what you are asking
about.

- **A question, setup help or an idea** ("how do I…", a token that is not being found,
  a verdict rule you would like): [Discussions](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/bridgewatch/discussions).
  The [README](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/bridgewatch#readme) answers
  most configuration questions, so it is worth a look first.
- **A reproducible bug:** [Issues](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/bridgewatch/issues),
  through the bug report form. For a wrong verdict, a fixture recording of the pipeline
  (GitLab only, see the form) is worth more than any description.
- **A security vulnerability:** report it privately through
  [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/bridgewatch/security/advisories/new),
  or if you cannot use GitHub, email opensource@distronode.com. See
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never open a public issue for one.
- **District AI, the product** (an account, a number, billing): bridgewatch is not
  part of it. Go to <https://www.distronode.com/support>.

The GitLab copy at <https://gitlab.com/distronode-corporation/bridgewatch> is a
read-only mirror; issues and pull requests live on GitHub.

⚠️ **This is a small project, not a support desk for your CI.** We read issues about
bridgewatch and fix the ones we can reproduce. We cannot debug your GitLab instance,
your GitHub Enterprise Server, your runners or your keyring, and an issue that is really
one of those will be closed with a pointer rather than an answer.
